## Memory

This agent keeps its own memory in `memory/`, built from [agent-memory-kit](https://github.com/cxweoth/agent-memory-kit).

- At the start of every conversation, read `memory/spec/BOOT.md` and the boot-layer rules in the table below.
- Read a triggered-layer rule file when its condition holds.
- The full spec copy is in `memory/spec/`; this agent's own settings are in `MEMORY_ARCH.md`.
